controls.title: Limit system access to authorized users
controls.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, and devices (including other information systems).

controls.title: Limit system access to types of transactions and functions
controls.description: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute.

controls.title: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with CUI rules
controls.description: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with CUI rules (as established by the CUI Registry) and organizational policies.

controls.title: Limit access to CUI on system media
controls.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

controls.title: Employ principle of least privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific duties and information systems privileges.

controls.title: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts
controls.description: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts and enforce lockout after a defined number of consecutive failed attempts.

controls.title: Provide session lock after inactivity
controls.description: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays after a period of inactivity.

controls.title: Terminate sessions after a defined condition
controls.description: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition.

controls.title: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing connections
controls.description: Authorize wireless access to the system prior to allowing such connections.

controls.title: Monitor and control remote access sessions
controls.description: Monitor and control remote access sessions.

controls.title: Route remote access via managed access control points
controls.description: Route remote access via managed access control points.

controls.title: Control CUI posted to publicly accessible systems
controls.description: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations.

controls.title: Separate duties of individuals to reduce risk of collusion
controls.description: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion.

controls.title: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions
controls.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs.

controls.title: Ensure personnel are aware of security risks
controls.description: Ensure that personnel are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of organizational information systems.

controls.title: Ensure personnel are trained to carry out their responsibilities
controls.description: Ensure that organizational personnel are adequately trained to carry out their assigned information security responsibilities.

controls.title: Provide security awareness training on recognizing threats
controls.description: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential threats, including social engineering attacks.

controls.title: Ensure actions of individual users can be traced
controls.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users so they can be held accountable for their actions.

controls.title: Create and retain system audit logs
controls.description: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity.

controls.title: Review and update logged events
controls.description: Review and update logged events.

controls.title: Alert in event of audit logging process failure
controls.description: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure.

controls.title: Collect information to enable monitoring of remote access
controls.description: Collect audit information (e.g., logs) from multiple components throughout the system to enable monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized activity, including remote access sessions.

controls.title: Periodically assess security controls
controls.description: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application.

controls.title: Develop and implement plans of action
controls.description: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems.

controls.title: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis
controls.description: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls.

controls.title: Establish configuration baselines
controls.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles.

controls.title: Establish and enforce security configuration settings
controls.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Establish and maintain control of user-installed software
controls.description: Establish and maintain a policy and process to govern the installation and use of software on organizational systems.

controls.title: Restrict, disable, or prevent use of nonessential programs
controls.description: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services.

controls.title: Apply deny-by-exception policy
controls.description: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software.

controls.title: Identify system users
controls.description: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices.

controls.title: Authenticate system users, processes, and devices
controls.description: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of those users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational information systems.

controls.title: Enforce minimum password complexity and change requirements
controls.description: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created.

controls.title: Prohibit reuse of passwords within a specified number of generations
controls.description: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations.

controls.title: Allow temporary passwords with immediate change requirement
controls.description: Allow temporary passwords for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password.

controls.title: Store and transmit only cryptographically protected passwords
controls.description: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords.

controls.title: Obscure feedback of authentication information
controls.description: Obscure feedback of authentication information.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.description: Use multi-factor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms
controls.description: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Establish an operational incident-handling capability
controls.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities.

controls.title: Track, document, and report incidents
controls.description: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization.

controls.title: Track, document, and report incidents to authorities
controls.description: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization; test the organizational incident response capability.

controls.title: Perform maintenance on organizational systems
controls.description: Perform maintenance on organizational systems.

controls.title: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel
controls.description: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel that perform maintenance.

controls.title: Require MFA to establish remote maintenance sessions
controls.description: Require MFA to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete.

controls.title: Protect system media, both paper and digital
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI, both paper and digital.

controls.title: Limit access to CUI on system media
controls.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users.

controls.title: Sanitize or destroy system media before disposal
controls.description: Sanitize or destroy information system media before disposal or reuse.

controls.title: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations
controls.description: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations.

controls.title: Limit physical access to authorized individuals
controls.description: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Protect and monitor the physical facility
controls.description: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems.

controls.title: Protect CUI during transport unless covered by alternative safeguards
controls.description: Protect system media containing CUI during transport using cryptographic mechanisms or alternative physical safeguards in the absence of such protections.

controls.title: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI.

controls.title: Ensure CUI is protected during and after personnel actions
controls.description: Ensure that CUI is protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers.

controls.title: Periodically assess risk to operations
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets, and individuals.

controls.title: Scan for vulnerabilities in systems periodically
controls.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified.

controls.title: Monitor information systems to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks
controls.description: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.

controls.title: Periodically assess the risk posed by suppliers
controls.description: Periodically assess the risk posed by the supply chain to organizational operations, assets, and individuals.

controls.title: Establish a process to identify and address weaknesses or deficiencies in supply chain
controls.description: Establish a process to identify, assess, and remediate potential weaknesses or deficiencies in supply chain elements.

controls.title: Monitor system boundaries
controls.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational information systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of the information systems.

controls.title: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components
controls.description: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks.

controls.title: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography to protect CUI
controls.description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI.

controls.title: Employ architectural designs and software development techniques
controls.description: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems.

controls.title: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography
controls.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems.

controls.title: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices
controls.description: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of use to present users.

controls.title: Identify, report, and correct information and system flaws
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct information and system flaws in a timely manner.

controls.title: Provide protection from malicious code
controls.description: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems.

controls.title: Update malicious code protection mechanisms
controls.description: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available.

controls.title: Perform periodic scans and real-time scans of files
controls.description: Perform periodic scans of the information system and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed.

controls.title: Monitor and detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks
controls.description: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response.

controls.title: Monitor organizational systems to detect potential attacks
controls.description: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks.
